sources.note: Nothing. Wordlist (SignWriting) lexicostatistics only: Ghandruk sec. 5.5 p. 8 (3+1 Deaf videoed, ~20 Deaf estimated), sec. 7.2.2 p. 12 and table p. 13 (63% vs Kathmandu NpSL, 53% vs Pokhara NpSL, 49% vs Jumla SL; 'only distantly related languages'). Sign-comparison parameters pp. 9-10 (handshape, location, movement, orientation, contact, non-manuals) are comparison criteria, not a phonology. No grammar, prosody or stress statement for any language in the report.
